name: Coordinator notes through a confined SSH key
summary: Opt-in Linux private adapter to the running .447 notes service: operator-enrolled host principals with recorded owner approval send/read/reply/mark noted/wait through the confined client without a site agent. HMAC challenge-response authenticates the trusted endpoint, and project scope, registry actor ownership and live enrollment are checked before every effect/pass. Text and receipts remain in the existing service store and are limited to the two coordinator projects. Default worker waits are unchanged.
